2026_02_JAX_DEN.headline: Jacksonville’s pocket discipline collides with Denver’s pressure and altitude advantage
2026_02_JAX_DEN.paragraph1: Jacksonville’s offense faces a demanding road environment in Denver, where Trevor Lawrence must avoid letting the Broncos’ rush turn second-and-long into repeated pressure downs. Denver is without Marvin Mims Jr., and RJ Harvey carried a hamstring question into the matchup, putting additional weight on Bo Nix and the remaining skill group to create explosives. The Jaguars can stress Denver if their protection remains firm; the Broncos need their defense to manufacture field-position advantages while the offense replaces missing speed.
2026_02_JAX_DEN.model_rationale: Jacksonville’s protection discipline and Denver’s ability to replace explosive-play speed should determine field position, drive sustainability and which quarterback operates from favorable down-and-distance situations.
